## Project Overview

### 0. Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config, show=F, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("analysis/0-config.R"))

############################
# File 01B data
############################
df_all <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_all.rds"))
df_mal <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_mal.rds"))
df_pne <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_pne.rds"))
df_dia <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_dia.rds"))

colnames(df_all)

```

### Create regression models.

* RQ 2: Does proximity to political unrest and terrorism have an effect on treatment seeking patterns?

```{r reg-run, warning=F, message=F, include=F}
#################################
# Create negative binomial
# regression models across diff
# exposure variables.
# (See 0-functions-analysis.R
# for helper function details.)
#################################
# 2ry analysis: Categorical exposure (proximity)
m2_all_any_loc <- negbin_helper(df_all, "event_any_loc")
m2_mal_any_loc <- negbin_helper(df_mal, "event_any_loc")
m2_pne_any_loc <- negbin_helper(df_pne, "event_any_loc")
m2_dia_any_loc <- negbin_helper(df_dia, "event_any_loc")

## glimpse of results
summary(m2_all_any_loc)
exp(summary(m2_all_any_loc)$coeff) #exponentiate to get IRR

```


### 2. Format results table. Download.
```{r create-table}

table_2ry_html <- 
  
  tab_model(
       m2_all_any_loc,
       m2_mal_any_loc,
       m2_pne_any_loc,
       m2_dia_any_loc,
       
       show.loglik=T,
       string.est = "IRR",
       string.ci = "95% CI",
       
       pred.labels = c("Intercept",
                       "Political unrest & terrorism (local, <=20 km)",
                       "Political unrest & terrorism (distant, >20 km)",
                       "Ramadan (0/1)",
                       "Rainfall (mm)"
                       ),
       
       dv.labels = c("Total Visits", 
                     "Malaria Visits", 
                     "Pneumonia Visits", 
                     "Diarrhea Visits") )

table_2ry_html

tab_model(
   m2_all_any_loc,
   m2_mal_any_loc,
   m2_pne_any_loc,
   m2_dia_any_loc,
   
   show.loglik=T,
   string.est = "IRR",
   string.ci = "95% CI",
   
   pred.labels = c("Intercept",
                   "Political unrest & terrorism (local, <=20 km)",
                   "Political unrest & terrorism (distant, >20 km)",
                   "Ramadan (0/1)",
                   "Rainfall (mm)"
                   ),
   
   dv.labels = c("Total Visits", 
                 "Malaria Visits", 
                 "Pneumonia Visits", 
                 "Diarrhea Visits"),
   
   file = paste0(table_path,"table-3-2ry-results.doc") )

```
